calLag.label: Same result exactly d days apart

cal2.label: Two-lookback calendar rules (games d1 and d2 days back agree)

cal3.label: Three-lookback calendar rules (games d1, d2 and d3 days back agree)

markov.label: Streak patterns: last 1-5 results -> next result

modular.label: Phase lattices: win rate by day number mod n (n = 2-60)

lz.label: Compressibility of the W/L sequence (Lempel-Ziv complexity)

named.label: 28/10 rule: games 28 and 10 days back agree

models.label: Season form (record so far, last season)

mechanisms.why: More rest than the opponent should help; does the line price it fully?
mechanisms.text: Back the side that is: 3+ more rest days than the opponent

mechanisms.why: Teams off a bye against teams that were not.
mechanisms.text: Back the side that is: off a bye (13+ days of rest) + opponent on 9 or fewer days of rest

mechanisms.why: Thursday games give the visitor a short week and a trip.
mechanisms.text: Back the side that is: home team + Thursday game

mechanisms.why: A 1 pm Eastern kickoff is 10 am on a Pacific body clock.
mechanisms.text: Fade the side that is: Pacific-time team + road team + game in the Eastern time zone + kickoff before 2 pm ET

mechanisms.why: At a night kickoff a Pacific team is at its daily peak while an Eastern team is 3 hours later in its day (the circadian finding of Smith et al., 1997).
mechanisms.text: Back the side that is: Pacific-time team + opponent is an Eastern-time team + night game (6:30 pm ET or later)

mechanisms.why: Road teams 2+ time zones from home.
mechanisms.text: Fade the side that is: road team 2+ time zones from home

mechanisms.why: The loser of the first meeting in a season, in the rematch.
mechanisms.text: Back the side that is: lost to this opponent earlier this season

mechanisms.why: After a 21+ point loss the market may overreact.
mechanisms.text: Back the side that is: team lost its last game by 21+

mechanisms.why: After a 21+ point win the market may overreact.
mechanisms.text: Fade the side that is: team won its last game by 21+

mechanisms.why: Teams that covered 3 straight: the line may chase them.
mechanisms.text: Fade the side that is: team covered its last 3

mechanisms.why: Teams that failed to cover 3 straight.
mechanisms.text: Back the side that is: team failed to cover its last 3

mechanisms.why: Division rivals know each other; underdogs may keep it closer.
mechanisms.text: Back the side that is: division game + underdog

mechanisms.why: Double-digit underdogs: the public backs favorites.
mechanisms.text: Back the side that is: underdog by 10+

mechanisms.why: In weeks 1-4 the line may lean too hard on last season.
mechanisms.text: Back the side that is: weeks 1-4 + losing record last season

mechanisms.why: Big favorites in night games draw public money.
mechanisms.text: Fade the side that is: favored by 7-9.5 + night game (6:30 pm ET or later); or Fade the side that is: favored by 10+ + night game (6:30 pm ET or later)

mechanisms.why: Control: nothing should happen. Home teams within 1.5 days of a full moon.
mechanisms.text: Back the side that is: home team + within 1.5 days of a full moon

mechanisms.why: The hand-found 10-day / 4th-previous rule as a bet: after 10 days, back a team whose last and 4th-previous games were wins, fade one whose were losses.
mechanisms.text: Back the side that is: last game exactly 10 days before + last and 4th-previous games both wins; or Fade the side that is: last game exactly 10 days before + last and 4th-previous games both losses

mechanisms.why: The hand-found 28/10 rule as a bet: back a team that won the games 28 and 10 days before, fade one that lost both.
mechanisms.text: Back the side that is: won the games 28 and 10 days before; or Fade the side that is: lost the games 28 and 10 days before
